Style bible for every image: wide 16:9 contemporary Chinese avant-garde minimalist stage sketch concept, pure warm paper-white seamless proscenium stage, bright high-key low-contrast lighting, abundant negative space, premium clean design. Stage architecture made of refined Rubik-like interlocking square modules: matte white and pale gray lightweight hollow frames, translucent pale-jade acrylic edges, slim ribs, precise seams, caster bases, visible joinery, elegant internal voids. Strong 拼接感: modules slide, rotate, quarter-turn, separate, and recombine. No colorful toy Rubik colors. No heavy crates. No projection, no LED screen, no hanging props, no suspended objects, no brush-stroke backdrop, no dense museum wall, no readable labels. Simple neutral off-white costumes. The stage world is an abstract Chinese dictionary revision system, physical and actor-operated.
Scene beat 5: scholarly dispute becomes visible. Two rival module paths fail to align: one path suggests thumb/body geometry, the other suggests sun/light geometry, both abstract. Performers pull two interlocking module clusters in opposite directions, leaving a precise square gap. Mood: intellectual tension, physical geometry, not dark.
